stem.text: A block of mass $2.0\,\text{kg}$ is released from rest on a slope. It travels $7.0\,\text{m}$ down the slope and falls a vertical distance of $3.0\,\text{m}$. The block experiences a frictional force parallel to the slope of $5.0\,\text{N}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a block on a slope, with labels 2.0 kg on the block, 7.0 m along the slope, and 3.0 m for the vertical height, with an arrow pointing down the slope.

stem.text: What is the speed of the block after falling this distance?
